protocol.serving_selection: validation normalized utility, then validation AUPRC
protocol.calibration_selection: lower validation Brier of Platt versus isotonic
protocol.threshold_selection: validation normalized utility after calibration for the serving model
protocol.masking: Retrain XGBoost on each variable subset. Count masks use the training-set raw observation rate, with official column order as the tie break. These runs are not used to choose the serving model.

serving.selection_rule: Maximum validation normalized utility of uncalibrated probabilities. Ties use validation AUPRC. The calibrator and the decision threshold are then fit on validation only.

calibration.selection: lower validation Brier; that Brier is fit and scored on the same rows
